svg.text: Two-stage XGBoost pipeline with frozen DNABERT-2 feature extraction
Raw nucleotides: A, C, G, T
Output: Top 20 Genes by Feature Importance (Gain)
These 20 genes determine which DNA sequences DNABERT-2 will embed
Each cell line's drug-sensitivity values WEIGHT the gene embeddings from DNABERT-2.
Cell line sensitive to EGFR drugs → context vector dominated by EGFR's DNA embedding.
Cell line resistant to BRAF drugs → BRAF's DNA embedding subtracted from context vector.
This is NOT concatenation — it is sensitivity-weighted matrix multiplication.
Trained on ~274 features (original + DNABERT-2 PCA embeddings)
Key Metric: Fusion Lift = Fusion_F1 − Baseline_F1
Positive lift → DNABERT-2 embeddings improved classification beyond raw sensitivity data
RECIST: CR / PR / SD / PD classification
Tier I–IV based on drug DB matches
Ranked treatment plan with confidence scores
Downstream: Clinical evidence, digital twin, Dx
Two XGBoost classifiers · Frozen DNABERT-2-117M · Sensitivity-weighted embedding fusion
